page_title: MON 1-1 MAI | B. Monchengladbach v Mainz 19/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Tobias Welz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' 1 - 1 Goal! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Moritz Nicolas into the bottom left corner.
90+7' It's a yellow card for Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach).
90+7' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

90+7' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Welz saw the whole situation. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Mainz.

90+4' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Moritz Nicolas didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
90+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' The whistle blows and Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) is booked for an infringement.
90+3' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) makes a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) is given a yellow card.
89' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
89' Celebrations are cut short for Mainz as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
89' Wait! Referee Tobias Welz has indicated he is going to review the Mainz goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
88' The ball from the free kick finds its way to Nelson Weiper (Mainz) who rises and scores with a thunderous header inside the left post. An incredible long-range header!
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Haris Tabakovic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kota Takai (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Daniel Batz comes off the line to clear the ball away.
85' Mainz are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
84' Mainz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nelson Weiper (Mainz) will replace Danny da Costa.
82' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
82' The attendance for today's match is 50245.
82' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
81' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas is prepared to thwart his effort.
79' Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) again sends a long-range pass to his teammate to start a counter attack.
77' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Paul Nebel departs the field of play to be replaced by William Boving (Mainz).
76' Urs Fischer has decided to make a change. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) replaces Anthony Caci.
76' The referee blows his whistle as Dominik Kohr (Mainz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
75' Some patient build-up play from Mainz as they look to unlock the defence.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin Stoger leaves the pitch and Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
72' Problems for Eugen Polanski as Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lukas Ullrich replaces him.
71' Eugen Polanski is forced to make a change. Kevin Diks is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach).
70' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
69' The Mainz players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
67' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Moritz Nicolas is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
66' Here's the change. Hugo Bolin leaves the pitch and Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as a substitute.
66' Urs Fischer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Armindo Sieb (Mainz) replacing Sheraldo Becker.
66' Here comes a substitution. Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Nikolas Veratschnig.

64' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
64' Daniel Batz (Mainz) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
64' 9:10 – the total goal attempt statistics.
60' Mainz keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
58' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
57' Some great controlled play and passing from Mainz. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

53' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Daniel Batz leaps like a salmon to deny him.
53' It looks like Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Welz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
51' The corner from Anthony Caci (Mainz) is cleared away by the defence.

51' Paul Nebel (Mainz) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Mainz get a corner.
51' The ball is cleared after Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
49' Anthony Caci (Mainz) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
47' A spell of possession for Mainz in an attempt to control the game.
46' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for an infringement.

43' A dangerous towering header by Dominik Kohr (Mainz) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
42' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) steps up to send the ball in.

42' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) received an accurate pass just outside the penalty area and produced a quick strike. It would have probably ended behind the goalkeeper, but one of the defenders managed to deflect it onto the post. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
41' Mainz are seeing far more of the ball now.
39' Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) produces a long-range pass.
36' B. Monchengladbach keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
35' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
35' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
35' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Mainz are going to take it.
35' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
34' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Good work from Mainz as they win a corner.
33' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
31' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
28' A cross into the box from Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.
26' A pass from Danny da Costa (Mainz) is intercepted by Moritz Nicolas and the move breaks down.
23' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
23' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Daniel Batz.
22' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
21' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
19' 2:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
17' A precise low pass is received by Hugo Bolin (B. Monchengladbach), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
14' Paul Nebel (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
12' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
12' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' B. Monchengladbach are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
9' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Welz blows for a foul.
7' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Hugo Bolin provided an assist for the goal.
6' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) receives a lofted cross on the edge of the box and sends a shot to the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no trouble saving this one.
6' Mainz hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
5' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
4' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
B. Monchengladbach will kick the game off.
